data.title: Socratic Autoraters (SOCREVAL) and Outcome-Driven Question Optimization (ODQS) for Socratic Students
data.description: Authoritative L400 architectural specification synthesizing SOCREVAL reference-free Socratic reasoning evaluation (Definition, Dialectic, and Maieutics with weakest-link step aggregation) and Outcome-Driven Question Optimization Strategy (ODQS: SELF-ODQS & PEER-ODQS SFT+DPO) for training high-utility Socratic Inquisitor and Critic agents in Google Cloud ADK 2.0.
